info.name: OutfitShop SS-MIS API v1 — Master Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for OutfitShop Ecommerce Clothing MIS & POS System.

Base URL: https://api.kesararamwithdigital.tech/api/v1

Access Tiers:
- TIER 1 PUBLIC: No token required
- TIER 2 AUTHENTICATED: Any logged-in employee (CASHIER, STAFF, MANAGER, ADMIN)
- TIER 3 MANAGER: Role MANAGER or ADMIN
- TIER 4 ADMIN: Role ADMIN only

Quick Start:
1. Run 'Login — Admin' in the Auth folder
2. Token is auto-saved to {{access_token}}
3. All authenticated requests use it automatically

item.name: TIER 1 — Authentication
item.description: Rate limited: 5 requests per minute. Login auto-saves token to {{access_token}}.

item.name: TIER 1 — Cart
item.description: Guest and customer session cart. Pass X-Session-ID header for guest tracking.

item.name: TIER 2 — Session Management
item.description: Requires Bearer token. Run a Login request first.

item.name: TIER 2 — Orders & POS Checkout
item.description: Use /orders/* for new integrations. /sales/* are legacy aliases that map to the same controller.
